nodes.name: AgentOrgRecovery.md
nodes.summary: Final code-audit report on Agent Org Recovery and consistency hardening: documents four rounds of post-live-run fixes (cutting the WakeNoop self-loop, persistent cross-session handoff, splitting member-idle vs task-complete receipts, treating run completion as real project acceptance), plus a watchdog analyze-then-execute rework, idempotent wake handling, persisted recovery budget, unified task eligibility/explicit-assignment logic, explicit member failure/shutdown/restart dispositions, atomic run-finality/task mutation, removal of stale auto-claiming, and a 10-layer architecture audit with state-ownership and entry-point-consistency matrices.
